track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: votes split between G and the 4th above it, and Daramad I votes the 4th. Vote kept.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on Fs in Zabol. The line peaks at G4 (400.1 Hz) at 0:10.0. It closes on the tonic (Fs4 → Fs4 → D4 → Bk3 → D4 → D4).
